name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast requirement against most backgrounds while remaining visible on both light and dark themes. The trade-off is slightly less crisp edges on high-DPI screens, but the clarity for keyboard users outweighs pixel-perfect precision.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring fails on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the blue blends into the pattern. A 5px #fff ring with a 1px #005fcc inner ring meets WCAG 2.2 AA on patterned light backgrounds and keeps crisp edges. Test both on a high-contrast patterned background to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 5px #fff outer ring with a 1px #005fcc inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA on patterned backgrounds by ensuring the white ring remains visible against high-contrast patterns, while the thin blue inner ring keeps the indicator crisp and recognizable. The trade-off is slightly reduced visibility on very dark backgrounds, but the white ring still outperforms the blue-only version in most real-world cases.

name: Reader
text: The 5px #fff ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on light patterned backgrounds where the white blends into the pattern. A 4px #005fcc ring with a 2px #fff inner ring meets WCAG 2.2 AA on both light and dark patterned backgrounds while keeping crisp edges. Test both on a high-contrast patterned background to settle it.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px #fff inner ring for focus indicators. The result must deliver a tested, WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant focus style artifact owned by Ramp.
